    if (c == '-') sign = -1, c = getchar();
    while (isdigit(c)) x = x * 10 + (c - '0'), c = getchar();
    return x * sign;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    ll n = read(), m = read(), P = read();
    
    vector<ll> fac(n + 2), inv(n + 2);
    fac[0] = inv[0] = 1;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= n + 1; ++i) {
        fac[i] = fac[i-1] * i % P;
    }
    auto fpow = [&](ll x, ll k) -> ll {
        ll res = 1, base = x % P;
        while (k) {
            if (k & 1) res = res * base % P;
            base = base * base % P;
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    };
    for (ll i = 1; i <= n + 1; ++i) {
        inv[i] = fpow(fac[i], P - 2);
    }
    
    auto C = [&](ll x, ll y) -> ll {
        if (x < y) return 0;

    };
    
    auto S = [](ll x) -> ll {
        return x * (x + 1) / 2;
    };
    
    vector<ll> f(m + 1), g(m + 1);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (ll j = 0; j < i; ++j) {

            f[i] = (f[i] + term) % P;
            
            ll inner = ((g[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % P + f[j] * g[i - 1 - j] % P) * (i + 1) % P 
                       + f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % P * (S(j) + S(i - 1 - j)) % P) % P;
            g[i] = (g[i] + inner * C(i - 1, j) % P) % P;
        }
        f[i] = f[i] * (i + 1) % P;
    }
    
    vector<vector<ll>> F(m + 1, vector<ll>(n + 1, 0));
    vector<vector<ll>> G(m + 1, vector<ll>(n + 1, 0));
    
    F[0][0] = 1;
    for (ll j = 0; j <= n; ++j) F[0][j] = 1;
    
    for (ll i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        F[i][i] = f[i];
        G[i][i] = g[i];
        for (ll j = i + 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            F[i][j] = F[i][j-1];
